title: PurSteam mop cleaner pads
text: PurSteam mop cleaner pads. These are effective pads that work with the Pursteam mop.  They are microfiberish... no scrubber texture but the floor is warm where the steamer runs and there is a sheen of water - so I believe the steam is effectively getting thru the pad. They machine wash well, I lay flat to dry in my dryer closet.
